questions.text:
Question 32.  
If it takes Bubble Sort 5 seconds to sort 4 million elements, what is the best estimate of how long will it take to sort 16 million 
elements? 
A) 20 seconds 
B) 25 seconds 
C) 64 seconds 
 
D) 80 seconds 
E)  100 seconds
questions.explanation:
Bubble sort is an O(N2) sort, so multiplying size by 4 would expect to multiply runtime by 
42. 5 * 4 * 4 = 80 seconds.

0 will produce the other. The number of true assignments must equal the number of false 
assignments, so the answer is 8.
